mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which was recently adopted by the Common Council to guide long-range growth. This follows an extensive process of public engagement and mapping exercises to ensure the plan reflects the values of our residents.

Today is a busy one for local activities, featuring Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 events, and Hop Haus trivia. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, followed by Puppets in the Park this Saturday.
In our weekly police report, on September 28, a 71-year-old man was cited following a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's of Verona is currently open and serving until 11 PM, so feel free to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
